items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: Well you and I have experienced some things with the Basie tour, night after night after night with them.

ctx.x: They would dance us to death when they’d come to Chicago, you know? Every number. And the ballads were just as pretty.
Well you and I have experienced some things with the Basie tour, night after night after night with them.
Yes. Listening to Sarah Vaughan and Jimmie Jones and Richard Davis and Roy Haynes with the Basie band playing those wonderful charts. Some by Al Cohn, some by Ernie Wilkins.
